closes: #38834


https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/38265 added bulk pause and resume of DAGs. However, this PR seems to reuse the cli util method that collects DAGs from the default dag folder but not from the metadata DB. Hence, this would cause the unpause command to fail on environments where the dag folder is missing.

review_comments:
@ephraimbuddy 
Because when we query matching dags in:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/d296cad70c7dbffc8a4e5e073188eb72034af1de/airflow/cli/commands/dag_command.py#L238
We get DagModel objects from this query, and they have the attribute `is_paused=True`

And then we unpause these Dags at:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/d296cad70c7dbffc8a4e5e073188eb72034af1de/airflow/cli/commands/dag_command.py#L255
The `set_is_paused` method of `DagModel` don't actually update the `is_paused` instance attribute, it only update the value in the metadata db. 

Hence if we do not put `not dag.get_is_paused()`, if one unpauses dags, the console will still print `is_paused=True` like this:
```
dag_id               | is_paused
=====================+==========
future_schedule_none | True     
```

I guess I can remove the `not` here. But then if one unpauses dags
The console will print the `dag_id` and the `is_paused` state as `True`, which is a bit misleading since if a user executes unpause command, they should see that the dag has been unpaused on their screen?
